queries.question: How many samples per group_name?
queries.sql: SELECT group_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM samples GROUP BY group_name ORDER BY group_name
queries.interpretation: group_name is a categorical code (A/B), counted not averaged. Each group has 2 samples; this is the sample grain (no join, no inflation).

queries.question: Mean strength by group for samples aged >= 7 days?
queries.sql: SELECT s.group_name, AVG(m.strength) AS mean_strength, COUNT(*) AS n_meas FROM samples s JOIN measurements m ON s.sample_id = m.sample_id WHERE s.age >= ? GROUP BY s.group_name ORDER BY s.group_name
queries.interpretation: Parameterized age filter (?=7). Join samples->measurements ON sample_id is one-to-many: sample 1 has 2 measurements, so n_meas counts MEASUREMENTS (A=3, B=2), not samples. AVG(strength) ignores NULL and is at measurement grain (A=(25+34+26)/3=28.33, B=(28+40)/2=34.0). For sample-grain means, aggregate measurements per sample first.
